name: crypto-predict15-15-lightgbm-l1-leaf-residual
notes: Iteration 14 direct monotone classification worsened log loss +0.000340 in every historical band even with only a 10 percent blend; monotonicity alone does not preserve the information already in market probabilities. Return to the successful residual target, using LightGBM leaf-wise squared-error fitting with both L1 and L2 leaf penalties, broad leaves and a 25 percent bounded correction. This tests sparse nonlinear corrections instead of replacing the market forecast. Historical development only. Required outputs: 100 asset/lead/probability cells, 5 lead summaries, 10 asset/lead summaries, 50 lead/bin calibration rows, and contract/forecast scores. Model comparison is prediction quality versus contemporaneous midpoint, never profitability. Five fixed leads, January-to-July history; full-day label embargo.

data.notes: Hash-verified acquired panel; source date predicate excludes all post-July labels before materialization.

features.notes: Fixed, causal transformations only. The target residual is label minus market probability and never enters features. known_ms imposes a full-day settlement-publication embargo.

asset.notes: Asset identity is available before settlement.

fit.notes: Fresh estimator per 30-day block; only labels published at least one full day earlier. No random early-stopping validation. calibration_baseline.notes: Market-only logit recalibration distinguishes extra predictive information from correcting market calibration.

eligible.notes: Exclude training warmup and failed fits by status; counts remain in fit evidence.

probability.notes: Predeclared shrinkage 0.25; probability clipped to [1e-6,1-1e-6]. Residual estimators minimize errors relative to the market, classifiers estimate settlement directly.

losses.notes: Proper scores evaluate the whole Bernoulli forecast. No payout, fee, spread hurdle, or trading rule.

paired.notes: Negative paired score differences favor the model; positive calibration gap means more YES settlements than the market implied.

probability_bin.notes: Fixed market-probability bins; models cannot move a difficult row to a different cell.

cells.notes: Descriptive fixed cell map; uncertainty and all 1500 attempted cells are retained in the study evidence.

leads.notes: Full model, raw-market and calibrated-market score comparison at each lead, pooled across assets.

asset_leads.notes: Asset-specific lead comparisons retain row, market and day denominators.

calibration.notes: Calibration surface: realized YES frequency versus mean model, raw-market and calibrated-market probabilities in each fixed market bin at each lead.

markets.notes: Average available leads once per contract before any overall comparison; correlated leads are not independent trials.
